parameters.tfidf: binary tf, smoothed idf ln((1+N)/(1+df))+1, row L2 norm
parameters.nmf: frobenius, cd solver, nndsvd init, max_iter 800, tol 1e-4

k_rule: most families reproduced at matched cosine >= 0.8, among ks with mean matched cosine >= 0.75; ties to the smaller k

stability.note: bootstrap: mean matched cosine of work loadings over resampled refits; init: 4 random-init + 1 nndsvda refit

membership_note: soft memberships are each family's share of the reconstructed column (works) or row (dissertations)
